reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Toner Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: Good as moisture tonner. But not seeing much after half bottle usage
reviews.zh: 當保濕toner幾好。但用咗半支都未見到太大效果。

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Toner Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: Lovely gel like toner. Fast absorbing and a little moisturizing. Love it!
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢支gel狀toner。吸收得快，而且有少少保濕。好鍾意！

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Toner Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: I like it make my dark pigmentation lighten. Only been using it for 3 weeks I hope it can help to remove my pigmentation
reviews.zh: 我鍾意佢幫我淡化咗啲深色色斑。只係用咗3星期，希望可以幫我啲色斑退走。

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Toner Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: One of my favs!! Totally obsessed with this!
reviews.zh: 我最愛之一！！完全着咗迷！

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Toner Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: とろみのあるトナーなので好みが分かれそうです！個人的にはあまり浸透してる気がしなくて使い心地が好きではなかったです！
reviews.zh: 係一款有黏稠感嘅toner，感覺會好見仁見智！就個人嚟講，唔太覺得滲透到皮膚，所以使用感覺唔係好鍾意！

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Toner Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: This is such a nice toner from Abib. It’s a bit thick and feels very hydrating. I haven’t used it long enough to say if it’s helped with dark spots, but I think it’ll be great to use in conjunction with a vit c serum
reviews.zh: Abib 呢支toner真係好好。有少少杰，但感覺好保濕。我未用得夠耐，未能講係咪幫到淡化色斑，但覺得配搭維他命C精華一齊用應該效果好好。

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Toner Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: Life changing experience with this toner might replace all the toner I’d love before
reviews.zh: 呢支toner改變咗我嘅護膚體驗，可能會取代晒我之前鍾意嘅所有toner。

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Toner Skin Booster 200ml
reviews.text: After a couple of weeks my skin seems slightly brighter. Hasn’t caused any breakouts to my combo skin.
reviews.zh: 用咗幾星期之後，皮膚感覺有少少提亮咗。混合性皮膚用咗都冇爆瘡。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
